findings.title: NUL byte or over-long path component in an entry path gives HTTP 500 instead of 400, and a stored entry with one makes the whole category GET fail
findings.evidence: src/api/routes/workbench_bookmarks.py:357-363 and 331-344; POST /entries path 'a.md\x00' -> 500, 300-char component -> OSError Errno 36; hand-edited record with a NUL entry -> GET /bookmarks/t ValueError
findings.consequence: A malformed path is a server error, and one malformed stored entry hides every other entry of its category (R11 degradation does not hold for it). No absolute path reaches the response body.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject NUL and segments over 255 characters in normalize_entry_path with 400; catch (OSError, ValueError) around resolve/is_file in _resolved_inside_repository and _entry_status.

findings.title: Nested .git directories are accepted as entries (only the first path segment is checked)
findings.evidence: workbench_bookmarks.py:302-304; POST 'sub/.git/config' -> 201 present, 'nested/.git/HEAD' -> 201; workbench.py:241 excludes .git at every depth; ADR-029 section 3 'nothing under .git'. Case variants (.GIT, _Private) unverified on a case-insensitive filesystem.
findings.consequence: Git internals of a nested checkout or worktree can be bookmarked and opened though the tree never offers them.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject when any path segment, casefolded, is in ALWAYS_EXCLUDED_NAMES; compare the first segment to '_private' casefolded.

findings.title: Category id validation (slug pattern, Windows reserved names, 64-char cap) is not pinned by any test
findings.evidence: Mutations removing the pattern fullmatch, the reserved-name check, and the length cap all leave 118 passed (SURVIVED). The guard itself is correct today.
findings.consequence: The ADR's named defence against write-path escape (backslash ids on Windows) can be deleted with the suite green.
findings.minimal_fix: Add unit tests of is_valid_category_id/_record_path for backslash, '..', uppercase, 'con', 'com1', 65 characters, empty, 'a--b'.

findings.title: 'First delivered file becomes the active tab' is untested against the real viewer panel
findings.evidence: Removing setActiveTabId(plan.assignments[0].tabId) in HtmlViewerRegion.tsx leaves vitest at 80 passed; the three-file test's expected 'Tab 1' is already active.
findings.consequence: ADR-029 section 6 point 8 clause can regress unnoticed; in a real session Tab 1 holds the overview page so the set opens in Tabs 2-4 and activation is what shows it.
findings.minimal_fix: Add a test that opens one file first, then three via openFiles, and asserts the selected tab is 'Tab 2'.
